content.title: Travel
content.text: Almost a million times each day, CBP officers welcome international travelers into the U.S. In screening both foreign visitors and returning U.S. citizens, CBP uses a variety of techniques to assure that global tourism remains safe and strong. Descriptions of CBP processes and programs are available for first-time and frequent travelers. For U.S. Citizens/Lawful Permanent Residents If you are a U.S. citizen traveling abroad, get the information you need to smoothly navigate your return back into the U.S.For International Visitors If you are a visitor to the U.S. coming to work, study, conduct business or immigrate, get the Information you need to smoothly navigate the process and procedures to enter the U.S.Trusted Traveler Programs CBP's Trusted Traveler Programs provide expedited travel for pre-approved, low-risk travelers through dedicated lanes and kiosks.Biometrics Discover how CBP has streamlined and enhanced the traveler experience by implementing advanced biometric facial comparison technology at ports of entry.Mobile Application Directory CBP offers a suite of mobile applications to help expedite the travel process when entering the United States, help customs brokers facilitate import inspections, and more.Advisories and Wait Times Get up-to-date information you need on Airport and Border wait times before you begin your travel.
